I have farmed this small plot for many years using the ways my mother taught me. I will plant the cassava cuttings I saved from last season's harvest, because the store-bought seed is too expensive and I do not trust it as much as my own. We do not use chemical fertilizer or spray on this plot — those things cost too much money and I am too old to learn new ways. My family will help me with the planting and harvesting when the rains come, but we cannot afford to pay workers.
